purpose: Measure severity-dependent post-processing robustness without changing the frozen Section 3 models or thresholds.

rules.interpretation: The matrix is a final stress test. Results may motivate future work but must not alter E1, E2, E3, or their validation-selected thresholds.

interpretation_guardrail: This final stress-test matrix must not be used to retrain E1-E3, change their validation-selected thresholds, or reselect the primary model.
